prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: 16:9 cinematic conference title background.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND PALETTE reference only: the selected engineering title artwork. Create a new scene, not a minor edit of that desk.
Concept: the iceberg relationship without a literal iceberg. A small, healthy application is all that is visible above a surface; the much larger build and delivery system is hidden below. Reinterpret an under-counter cutaway in a DevOps engineering setting.
Scene: an unusually precise architectural cutaway photograph of a raised-floor engineering room, like an expertly hand-built practical film set. RIGHT 46 percent: at roughly one-third of frame height, a THIN horizontal charcoal floor slab holds one small upright application display. Its UI is extremely simple: three ivory blocks and one sage healthy indicator, no words. Above the slab: restrained, empty, ordinary space. BELOW that same slab the wall and floor have been cut away, revealing a deep, dark multi-level machinery pit occupying the remaining two-thirds of the image. Show a coherent route through a few recognizably different delivery mechanisms: a compact build-compute chassis, removable artifact cassettes, a sealed release mechanism, cable looms and connected power/identity interfaces. These belong to one carefully constructed continuous system, with stairs/structural framing giving depth and scale. The app display is small; the unseen supporting infrastructure is many times larger. A thin restrained amber route links the machinery upward to the app; one tiny coral connector deep below hints at how an unseen component could affect the route. No literal measured proportions.
Art direction: quiet and ominous, strong cutaway silhouette, sophisticated cinematic chiaroscuro, matte graphite structure, dark petrol depths, burgundy enamel details, brushed steel, warm amber work lights, occasional muted sage. Photographic tactility, subtle film grain, authored architectural composition. The remembered image must be the tiny visible app above a surface and the large invisible delivery system beneath it, not a bank of screens or random electronics.
Composition: LEFT 54 percent remains calm near-black shadow with faint texture for large native white title typography. Confine the cutaway, small app and machinery to the right. The floor surface should be immediately legible and the below-floor mass dominant. A low oblique camera looking into the exposed pit creates dramatic depth, not a flat infographic.
Constraints: no food, kitchen, water, ocean, literal iceberg, giant white paper, people, desks full of gadgets, invented dashboards, stock server racks, infinity loops, padlocks, cyber grids, blue neon, holograms or floating icons. No generated words, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Do not render title typography. The result must look deliberately art-directed rather than a generic AI technology illustration.
